title: Comprehensive Action Plan for cFish.io Optimization

metadata.purpose: Define a comprehensive action plan for optimizing cFish.io systems for April 2025 relaunch
metadata.targetAudience: tY FischEYe and UcF leadership team
metadata.author: Claude 3.7 Sonnet

executiveSummary: This comprehensive action plan provides a structured approach to optimize cFish.io's systems and align technical capabilities with business objectives for the April 2025 relaunch. Building on the foundation of the existing seven-department structure and integrated platforms, the plan focuses on completing critical technical implementations while positioning documentation excellence as a primary market differentiator. The plan is organized into a 30-day implementation timeline with four weekly phases, each with specific objectives and success metrics.
